item.title: India vs New Zealand: T20 World Cup 2026 Final Set for Ahmedabad Showdown
item.description: GUWAHATI: The ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 final will take place at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday, March 8, where India will face New Zealand in a highly anticipated clash. India enter the match as the defending champions and will be aiming to become the first team to successfully defend the T20 World Cup title on home soil, while New Zealand are chasing their first-ever men’s white-ball world trophy. item.title: YouTuber Anurag Dobhal Crashes Car at 150 kmph During Instagram Live, Admitted to ICU
item.description: GUWAHATI: Popular YouTuber and Bigg Boss 17 contestant Anurag Dobhal, widely known as UK07 Rider, was hospitalised after crashing his car during an Instagram Live session on Saturday night, March 7.
